school_use.en: Used during snack time and repeated play routines.
school_use.es: Se usa durante la merienda y en rutinas de juego repetidas.

short_family_guidance.en: Use it when your child asks for more food, more play or another turn.
short_family_guidance.es: Úsalo cuando tu hijo pida más comida, más juego u otro turno.

teacher_message.en: We are using MORE during familiar snack and play routines.
teacher_message.es: Usamos MÁS durante rutinas habituales de merienda y juego.

family_message.en: The group is using MORE. You can repeat the same cue during snack time at home.
family_message.es: El grupo está usando MÁS. Puedes repetir la misma señal durante la merienda en casa.

approved_source_context.scope: Approved for prototype wording preparation; not linguistic sign certification.

school_use.en: Used when a familiar meal begins.
school_use.es: Se usa al comenzar una comida habitual.

short_family_guidance.en: Use it when food is offered or when a familiar meal begins.
short_family_guidance.es: Úsalo al ofrecer comida o al comenzar una comida habitual.

try_it_during.en: Try it during a familiar meal.

teacher_message.en: We are introducing EAT during familiar mealtime routines.
teacher_message.es: Introducimos COMER durante rutinas habituales de comida.

family_message.en: You can repeat the EAT cue when a familiar meal begins at home.
family_message.es: Puedes repetir la señal COMER al comenzar una comida habitual en casa.

approved_source_context.scope: Approved for prototype wording preparation; not linguistic sign certification.

school_use.en: Used when water is offered during a familiar routine.
school_use.es: Se usa al ofrecer agua durante una rutina habitual.

short_family_guidance.en: Use it when offering water during a familiar school or home routine.
short_family_guidance.es: Úsalo al ofrecer agua durante una rutina habitual en la escuela o en casa.

try_it_during.en: Try it when drinks are offered.

teacher_message.en: We are using WATER when drinks are offered.

family_message.en: You can repeat the WATER cue when offering a drink at home.
family_message.es: Puedes repetir la señal AGUA al ofrecer una bebida en casa.

approved_source_context.scope: Approved for prototype wording preparation; not linguistic sign certification.

school_use.en: Used as a familiar meal or activity comes to an end.
school_use.es: Se usa cuando termina una comida o actividad habitual.

short_family_guidance.en: Use it when a familiar meal or activity is coming to an end.
short_family_guidance.es: Úsalo cuando una comida o actividad habitual esté terminando.

try_it_during.en: Try it at the end of playtime.

teacher_message.en: We are using ALL DONE at the end of familiar routines.
teacher_message.es: Usamos TERMINADO al final de rutinas habituales.

family_message.en: You can repeat the ALL DONE cue as a familiar activity ends at home.
family_message.es: Puedes repetir la señal TERMINADO cuando finalice una actividad habitual en casa.

approved_source_context.scope: Approved for prototype wording preparation; not linguistic sign certification.

school_use.en: Used when help is offered or requested during a familiar task.
school_use.es: Se usa al ofrecer o pedir ayuda durante una tarea habitual.

short_family_guidance.en: Use it when offering or asking for help during a familiar task.
short_family_guidance.es: Úsalo al ofrecer o pedir ayuda durante una tarea habitual.

teacher_message.en: We are using HELP during familiar tasks and play.
teacher_message.es: Usamos AYUDA durante tareas y juegos habituales.

family_message.en: You can repeat the HELP cue during a familiar task at home.
family_message.es: Puedes repetir la señal AYUDA durante una tarea habitual en casa.
